In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="SWGA" /> the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] undertook a '''mission to Utapau''' to investigate the [[death]] of the [[Gender|female]] [[Jedi]] Master [[Tu-Anh]] whilst she was on the [[planet]] [[Utapau]]. While investigating, they discovered a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] conspiracy to create a [[Death Star|powerful weapon]] using a massive [[kyber crystal]]. The two infiltrated the base of those dealing in the crystal and briefly claimed it, but it was later reclaimed by [[General]] [[Grievous]].<ref name="Crystal Crisis" /> The Jedi pursued and eventually destroyed the crystal, having learnt from [[Yoda]] that it was a powerful artifact of ancient legend.<ref name="The Big Bang" />
